title: Orchestrator project manifest (orchestrator.json)
description: Wire contract for the downloadable project manifest — parent plan Section 10.3, reproduced key-for-key (FR-PRJ-03). Required keys are exactly the plan's; `$schema` and `agent_hints` are the optional extended keys the example carries. `additionalProperties: false` is the FR-SEC-04 guarantee: a rendered manifest can contain nothing beyond this allowlist, so no secret material fits. Published file: `schemas/manifest.v1.json` (repository-local; the `$id`/`$schema` URL host is the plan example's placeholder — recorded in the WP-1.3 changelog for WP-2.2 to confirm).

$schema.description: Location of this schema (Section 10.3 example value; optional key).

orchestrator_api.description: API base URL the bridge calls (Section 9.10 configuration — ORCHESTRATOR_API_BASE_URL; never baked into code, NFR-06).

auto_branch_prefix.description: Canonical branch prefix with {PID} resolved (G-09; Section 7.2 policy branch_prefix).

audit_required_default.description: Default audit_required for new tasks (Section 7.2 policy).

worktree_mode.description: Whether per-task worktrees are advised (Section 10.3 example: false; ADR-013).
